propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been the product manager for the integrations area of a developer analytics suite for four years, writing the product requirements for the source control and ticketing integrations and running discovery calls with engineering leaders at twenty customer accounts, after two years as a business analyst at a software consultancy.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the roles, the years and the requirements work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate prioritised the integrations backlog with the feature team under the suite's weighted scoring method, reported integration adoption to the leadership team each quarter, and wrote the roadmap boundary note for the integrations area.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the prioritisation, the adoption reports and the boundary note.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has seven years of product management experience and set pricing and packaging for the suite.
propositions.rationale: The resume documents four years as a product manager and two as a business analyst, with pricing and packaging set by the director of product; the seven years and the pricing ownership come from the screen and the agency summary.

expectedGap: The materials document four years of product management and two years as a business analyst, with pricing and packaging set by the director of product; they do not document seven years of product management or the candidate setting pricing.
expectedBoundaryNote: State the years by role title as the resume gives them and keep pricing and packaging with the director of product.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the employment dates by role title and for the pricing decision records naming who set the suite's pricing.
